llm_response.reason: The website presents a professional, extensive catalogue of legitimate IT and office products, sporting appropriate market prices (not suspiciously low), and does not make implausible offers or exploit psychological weaknesses. Company details match legitimate registrations (Bechtle AG, an established business), WHOIS and RCS records are verifiable, payment and privacy information are standard, and there are no signs of urgency tactics, pop-ups, or unusual payment requests. Overall, it exhibits none of the characteristics typical of scam websites.
